serve_audio_segment: serve an audio file segment as WAV by extracting frames between start and end timestamps
get_file_lines: count and return the total number of lines in a gzipped or plain text file
get_annotations: retrieve annotation lines from a TSV or ZIP file within a given index range
open_segment_tsv: parse a range of lines from a TSV file into structured LineResult objects with audio and text columns
general_query: handle a unified query that routes to annotations or audio serving based on the input path format
